characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden is a young man of modest build with unkempt, dark brown hair and a determined look in his eyes. He wears simple, worn-out clothes, consisting of a beige tunic and brown trousers, suitable for a peasant. Often depicted carrying a large wooden kneading trough on his back, Askeladden displays both resilience and ingenuity. He exudes an air of innocence and resourcefulness, always ready for challenge despite his humble origins.

characters.name: Troldet
characters.description: The troll, known as Troldet, is a massive and fearsome creature with rough, grayish skin and a wild appearance. He has long, shaggy hair and pronounced, unkempt facial hair. His clothing is primitive, made from rough, natural materials, and he often has an expression of anger or annoyance, especially when thwarted by Askeladden. Troldet lives across the water from the royal palace, in a rugged mountain dwelling fitting his brutish and formidable nature.

characters.name: Trolddatteren
characters.description: Trolddatteren is the daughter of the troll, having a humanoid appearance but with distinct features akin to her father, such as rough skin and wild hair. She wears a simple dress that matches the rugged style typical of the troll's dwelling. Trolddatteren is initially depicted with a sense of duty to her father, yet naive enough to be tricked by Askeladden.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: The King, known as Kongen, is a regal and authoritative figure, often depicted in a luxurious robe embellished with gold trimmings, and wearing a golden crown. He has an imposing presence, with a beard that denotes wisdom and power. Residing in the royal palace, Kongen exudes authority but also a sense of fairness, rewarding Askeladden for his accomplishments.

characters.name: Kokkejenten
characters.description: Kokkejenten is a friendly and hardworking kitchen maid at the royal palace. She is young, with her hair tied back in a practical bun and wearing a plain, functional apron over her dress. Known for her kindness, she is one of the first to appreciate Askeladden's hard work and diligence in the palace.

characters.name: Kongsdatteren
characters.description: The princess, known as Kongsdatteren, is a graceful and elegant young woman, often portrayed in a beautiful gown adorned with intricate embroidery. She embodies royal poise and charm, having an aura of amicability. She becomes an integral part of Askeladden's reward, marrying him after his successful quest.
